title: Periscope template
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 20 (Periscope template (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 20: Designing a periscope. To understand how two mirrors at 45° in a periscope use reflection to see over obstacles

questions.q: Draw a ray through a periscope.
questions.a: Ray enters the top window, reflects down off the 45° mirror, reflects off the bottom mirror out to the eye
questions.model: Arrow in at the top window. At the top mirror, angle in equals angle out: it turns down. At the bottom mirror it turns again to the eye.

questions.q: Why must the mirrors be parallel?
questions.a: So the light comes out travelling the same way it went in

questions.q: Name one use of a periscope.
questions.a: Submarines, seeing over crowds or walls

questions.q: Build a periscope from a juice carton or card and two plastic mirrors following the sheet (adult cuts). Test it and draw the ray path.
questions.a: Working periscope; ray diagram with two 45° reflections
questions.model: Teacher builds one live: cut two windows, slot mirrors at 45°, tape, test over the desk.

questions.q: What would you change to make the image brighter?
questions.a: Bigger windows or bigger mirrors to let in more light

questions.q: How could you see round a corner instead of over a wall?
questions.a: Turn the periscope on its side.

questions.q: Big question: how could two mirrors help a submarine crew see?
questions.a: Light reflects off the top mirror down the tube and off the bottom mirror into the eye.
